name: Lookup Drug
action_description: Search the FDA NDC database for a single drug entry and return the match result - no records are created or modified

inputs.name: transcript_name
inputs.label: Transcript Name
inputs.description: Drug name as the contact said it, lowercased

inputs.name: generic_name
inputs.label: Generic Name
inputs.description: Generic name of the drug, including salt forms

outputs.name: match_status
outputs.label: Match Status
outputs.description: Result of the lookup: 'Match', 'No Match', or 'Ambiguous'

outputs.name: ndc
outputs.label: NDC
outputs.description: Normalized 11-digit NDC if matched, otherwise null

outputs.name: drug_label
outputs.label: Drug Label
outputs.description: Human-readable drug label if matched (brand + form + strength)

outputs.name: form
outputs.label: Form
outputs.description: Dosage form (e.g. tablet, capsule) if matched, otherwise null

outputs.name: dosage
outputs.label: Dosage
outputs.description: Dosage strength (e.g. '20 mg/1') if matched, otherwise null

outputs.name: package_description
outputs.label: Package Description
outputs.description: Description of the selected package when matched (e.g. '30 TABLET in 1 BOTTLE')

outputs.name: failure_reason
outputs.label: Failure Reason
outputs.description: Machine code for why the match did not resolve: 'no_match', 'ambiguous_name', 'ambiguous_form', 'ambiguous_dosage', 'ambiguous_package', or 'api_error'

outputs.name: failure_message
outputs.label: Failure Message
outputs.description: Human-readable explanation of why the match failed, ready for display

outputs.name: candidate_matches
outputs.label: Candidate Matches
outputs.description: JSON array of display strings when match_status is 'Ambiguous': drug names for 'ambiguous_name', form names for 'ambiguous_form', dosage strengths for 'ambiguous_dosage', package descriptions for 'ambiguous_package'

outputs.name: candidate_count
outputs.label: Candidate Count
outputs.description: Number of drugs that the lookup resulted in. For a 'Match' this should be 1, for 'No Match' this should be 0, and for 'Ambiguous' this should be >1
